decisions.reason: As an award-winning stollen that remained visible in 2024, it appears to exceed aspiration levels for a close-to-core seasonal product, so management would be very unlikely to reallocate its resources away from it.

Because this bread stayed on its own product page across both years and fits the firm's established bread capabilities, its performance likely meets acceptable aspirations, though without standout signals it still carries some review risk.

This marzipan stollen has been retained on its own page over two seasons and is closely aligned with the firm's traditional holiday assortment, suggesting satisfactory results relative to aspiration even if not as clearly exceptional as product B.
